subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT a tributary of the Indus River?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gomti**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Gomti River is a tributary of the Ganges River, not the Indus River.
 
• The Gomti River originates from Gomat Taal (Fulhar Jheel) near Madho Tanda, Pilibhit in Uttar Pradesh, India.
 
• The major cities along the Gomti River include Lucknow, which is the capital of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• The river has religious significance and is mentioned in Hindu scriptures as the daughter of Sage Vashishta.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Indus River**

 
 
• The Indus River is one of the longest rivers in the world, flowing through China (Tibet), India, and Pakistan.
 
• It originates from the Tibetan Plateau in the vicinity of Lake Mansarovar.
 
• Major tributaries of the Indus River include the Jhelum, Chenab, Ravi, Beas, and Sutlej rivers.
 
• The river is crucial for the economy of Pakistan, providing water resources for agriculture and hydroelectric power generation.
 
 
 
• **Chenab River**
 
 
• The Chenab River is a major river that flows in India and Pakistan.
 
• It is formed by the confluence of the Chandra and Bhaga rivers in the Lahaul and Spiti district in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh.
 
• The river flows through the Jammu region of Jammu and Kashmir, and then into Punjab, Pakistan.
 
 
 
• **Ravi River**
 
 
• The Ravi River is one of the five rivers of the Punjab region in northwestern India and eastern Pakistan.
 
• It originates in the Himalayas in the Indian state of Himachal Pradesh and flows along the Indo-Pak border for some distance before entering Pakistan.
 
 
 
• **Beas River**
 
 
• The Beas River is another important river in northern India.
 
• It originates in the Himalayas in central Himachal Pradesh, India, and flows for some 470 kilometers to the Sutlej River in the Indian state of Punjab.
